verdict.rationale: Docs show dedicated vertical endpoints/categories including news ('real-time news articles from thousands of trusted sources'), images (billions of images with filtering), video search, local/POI search, and rich search verticals like sports/stocks/weather, alongside date-based freshness filters (pd/pw/pm/py) for recency. Missing for 10: a documented finance-specific endpoint (only general 'stocks' vertical mentioned) and independent third-party corroboration of vertical query behavior beyond first-party docs.
